channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-machine-learning
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: HypercubeWTF — via awesome-machine-learning
item.description: Frozen hypercube reservoir for static fields (synthetic-time orbit + thin CNN readout). Sibling of HypercubeESN.

item.title: HypercubeHopfield — via awesome-machine-learning
item.description: Modern Hopfield associative memory on a hypercube graph with sparse local-attention retrieval (C++23 + Python).

item.title: HypercubeESN — via awesome-machine-learning
item.description: Echo State Network on a Boolean hypercube reservoir: XOR Hamming-1 connectivity, no stored adjacency, C++23 + Python (pip install hypercube-esn).

item.title: HypercubeCascade — via awesome-machine-learning
item.description: Etalon transit then WTF orbit on one cube, then a thin HypercubeCNN readout.

item.title: pyinterpret — via awesome-machine-learning
item.description: Unified API for SHAP, LIME, permutation importance, and partial dependence explanations.

item.title: deepseek-v4-flash-0731-in-c — via awesome-machine-learning
item.description: A native C CPU inference engine for running the 284B-A13B DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 on one laptop, reaching up to 1.12 token/s on tested hardware while streaming the 167 GB checkpoint from disk with a tested 8 GB memory path and no GPU or Python.

item.title: CosmoEdge — via awesome-machine-learning
item.description: A C++ edge video AI engine for RTSP ingestion, CV/VLM inference, visual pipeline orchestration, alarms, and event delivery on Sophon and Rockchip NPUs.
